name: i18n
title: I18n
author: @fma-ds/ds
description:
Puts every registry item in one language with a single optional provider. Without it, items render their English text.

- **`FmaI18nProvider`**: fixed language, the route's, another library's, or its own (`setLocale`, detection, packs loaded on demand). Switching keeps the old language until the new pack loads, so languages never mix.
- **Precedence**: an item's `i18n` prop, then `overrides`, then the active language, then the fallback, then English.
- **`useFmaMessages`** reads a namespace; **`useFmaLocale`** gives a language selector what it needs.
- **Server rendering**: `loadFmaMessages` and `parseAcceptLanguage` in a route loader. The store is per provider, so requests never share a language.

Don't edit this item: it holds the types and English of every item, so adding one overwrites it. Customize through `overrides`.
